_notes.timestamp.extractor: RecordField on event_ts, not Wallclock. Partitioning by ingestion time means a replay writes yesterday's events into today's partition and every backfill silently corrupts the warehouse.
_notes.flush.size + rotate.interval.ms: Two triggers on purpose: high-volume topics roll on size to keep Parquet files near 128 MB, low-volume topics roll on time so freshness SLAs are still met when traffic is thin.
_notes.parquet over json: Columnar at the landing zone means the warehouse external tables prune by column and partition. On this event volume it is roughly a 6x scan reduction versus newline JSON.
